speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis (secondary stage rash). Given the maternal history of treated gonorrhea and the onset of a generalized rash on day 4 without systemic signs, this presentation is highly suggestive of syphilis, which often presents with a maculopapular rash on palms and soles. I recommend immediate initiation of Penicillin G therapy pending confirmation via dark-field microscopy or serology if available.
